- [IRET.28.16.2] **Model-based property test.** Random `put/get/del/
  iterate` streams over a small key domain against a reference `dict`
  (sorted assoc array); assert membership/value/`len` equivalence and
  `ds_oa_check` after every op. Domains **must** include collision storms
  (cap ≪ domain) and grow-boundary crossings (insert exactly to each grow
  threshold).
